Name: Netorare Valley (Valley Girls Event Add on)
Author: Loki101idk
Description:
I originally made this mod for personal use however it's now gotten big enough I feel it would be better public. I am not a coder, writer, or artist thus this will have a lot of bugs so please comment them so I can fix them. I would like to redo alot of the writing and event progression which is part of why I want to make this public so that people may suggest dialogue that better fits the character. Most of the art is from Valley girls or Harem Valley just moved around or changed in GIMP so if you want to change the art from this mod that would be greatly appreciated. Adds events with Demetrius and the girls which can be toggled with Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM) if you don't want those.

Note:
To see these events you have to befriend the girls counterpart(ex. Abigail/Sebastian) most are 2 Hearts for first event then 4 for the next.
In other words you will have to be 2 hearts with Sebastian to see Abigail's first NTR event.

Warning: Humiliation, incest, infidelity, Cuckoldry,

How to Download:

1. download Valley girls install and its dependency's.

2. download Unfaithful Valley Girls - MILFs and Poly Addon (VALLEY GIRLS ADDON) install and its dependency's.

3. download Netorare Valley and move the file to [CP] VALLEY GIRLS folder in steamapps/common/Stardew Valley/Mods. *Make sure to hit Replace files
